## Problem and behavior

What changes for the user or contributor? Link the existing design/tracker when applicable.

## Decisions and scope

Explain consequential choices, assumptions and intentionally excluded work.

## Verification

List actual commands/manual scenarios and outcomes. Distinguish static, fixture, native runtime, live-provider and stress evidence; state what was not run and why.

For visual changes, attach a useful screenshot when safe to share. Otherwise say what you inspected and why there is no image. If visual inspection is still open, say why. Follow the [screenshot and privacy guidance](../CONTRIBUTING.md#verification-and-pull-requests).

## Remaining work

Link deferred checks or open decisions in their canonical owners.
